records.title: Serena Williams Returns to Pro Tennis After Four-Year Hiatus
records.summary: PARIS (AP) — Serena Williams is coming back to professional tennis at the age of 44, returning to the sport she dominated for two decades before famously “evolving” away from the daily grind of competition.

records.title: McDonald’s Bets on Fancier Chicken, Airier Restaurants to Keep Luring Diners
records.summary: McDonald’s Corp. is betting on everything from fancier chicken to new playgrounds as part of a campaign to make fast food feel less like fast food.

records.title: Australian LNG Workers to Start Strikes at Inpex’s Ichthys Plant
records.summary: Workers at Inpex Corp.’s Ichthys liquefied natural gas export project in Australia will start strikes after talks between union members and the company stalled.

records.title: Tracking Down Ebola Survivors in Remote Mountains to Find a Cure
records.summary: One scientist studies blood samples, sees lasting effect almost 20 years after infection

records.title: Anthropic’s First-Mover IPO Edge Set to Widen Lead Over OpenAI
records.summary: Anthropic PBC pulled ahead of OpenAI with its confidential IPO filing Monday, as the free-spending artificial intelligence startups battle for a fundraising edge that’s set to determine who will win the ultimate battle for computing power.
